title: A Twilight Wine Adventure with 3-Course Dinner
includes: A gourmet cheese sample plate at one of the winery stops
Stops at 4 of Niagara’s finest wineries (12-16 total wine tastings)
Indulgent 3-course dinner at one of Niagara's best local restaurants
An expert guide who's fun, friendly, and knowledgeable
Pick up and drop off at a single location within Niagara Falls or Niagara-on-the-Lake
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
We only provide pickup services for tour groups within Canada, not the United States.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A gorgeous sunset. Rich wine. A delicious dinner. What more could you ask for?!

Our Dinner Tour takes you on an amazing journey in the twilight hours to some of the best wineries in Niagara. You’ll indulge in tastings at 4 of Niagara’s best wineries before ending the evening with a 3-course dinner at one of the BEST restaurants in the area.
